name: Amamane
source:
Even though Seiichi was better at baseball than everyone else, he was unable to perform at his peak during games due to his nerves. He trained hard by himself to get over his stage fright, but it only resulted in him overworking himself and collapsing on the scorching grounds. His kouhai Satsuki held him in her arms and told him:

“I’ll become your girlfriend and your manager and support you fully so that this will never happen again!”

Thus, she started helping him with everything, from his practices to his private life. Naturally that includes lap pillows and homemade bentos, but sometimes also having sex.

“You’re too harsh on yourself, senpai. So I’ll pamper you in return♪”

Seiichi was happy for her affection, but he wished to give it his all during training.　Satsuki believed in his true strength, but she wished for him to be happier.　Their youthtime match starts now!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/02/21/february-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
尽管精一在棒球方面比其他人都出色，但由于紧张，他在比赛中无法发挥出巅峰状态。他为了克服怯场而刻苦训练，结果却是劳累过度，倒在了灼热的地面上。他的后辈小月把他抱在怀里告诉他：

“我会成为你的女朋友，你的经纪人，全力支持你，不会再有这样的事情发生！”

因此，她开始在一切事情上帮助他，从他的练习到他的私生活。当然，这包括膝枕和自制便当，但有时也包括性行为。

“学长你对自己太苛刻了。所以我会宠你一下♪”

诚一为她的爱而感到高兴，但他希望在训练期间全力以赴。　小月相信他真正的力量，但她希望他更幸福。　他们的青春赛现在开始了！
